Algorithm:

3. Walk nCount entries from last to first in 0x40-byte strides.

  pCollection: FCallbackEntryCollection_Partial * - callback entries and recursion/compaction state.
  pCallbackArgument: void * - adapter-specific packet forwarded unchanged.

  void.
